19NOV26: The offers due date has been pushed to 30 November 2026, NLT 1:30 PM CST for now. Further changes including Q&As are forthcoming. Thank you.  

  

 29OCT26: Grand Forks AFB, ND is seeking to replace existing, and procure & install two 8-ton Computer Room Air Conditioner (CRAC) system along with preventative and emergency maintenance & repair services consistent with the PWS attached to this notice. Please review all attachments to this notice for complete details.
